proposals.value: Elle est plus bonne que moi.

evidence.notes: Paired with the 719 correct form Elle est meilleure que moi. Bon has the irregular comparative meilleur, so the regular plus bonne is the learner error; the context names meilleur, mieux and pire. Confidence high.

Paired with the 719 correct form une femme généreuse. Généreux has the irregular feminine généreuse (-eux to -euse), so leaving the masculine form is the learner error; the context names généreux to généreuse. Confidence high.

entity_key.title: Irregular imperative of être, avoir, savoir

evidence.notes: The correct tu imperative of avoir is aie, with no -s (context lists aie, ayons, ayez). Adding -s by analogy with regular -er verbs is the learner error. Confidence high.

entity_key.title: Irregular stem of être in imparfait

evidence.notes: The correct forms are j'étais, nous étions (given in the context): être has the irregular imparfait stem ét-. Building the imparfait from the regular nous-present stem sommes (somm-) is the learner error the rule warns about. Confidence moderate-high.

Paired with the 720 correct form nous avons (liaison obligatoire : nous-z-avons). The final -s of nous must link with the following vowel and sound [z]; pronouncing the two words separately omits the required liaison. Confidence high.
Paired with the 720 correct form On part demain. On always takes the third person singular, even when it means nous, so conjugating it like nous (partons) is the learner error. Confidence high.

Paired with the 720 correct form Elle sait jouer du piano. Connaître takes a direct object and is never followed by an infinitive or clause, as the source states; using it before an infinitive is the learner error. Confidence high.

Paired with the 720 correct form ils parlent [il paʁl]. The -e, -es and -ent endings of regular -er verbs are silent, so pronouncing the -ent is the learner error described in the source. Confidence high.
Paired with the 720 correct form un vieil homme. Vieux must become vieil before a masculine singular noun beginning with a vowel or mute h, so keeping vieux is the learner error. Confidence high.

entity_key.title: State verbs: imparfait vs passé composé meaning change

proposals.value: Tout à coup, il semblait comprendre la situation.

evidence.notes: The context contrasts the state reading (Il semblait déprimé) with the sudden change (Tout à coup il a semblé comprendre). A sudden change or event requires the passé composé, so the imparfait here is the learner error. Confidence high.
